seo.title: DOM VIRUS blog: the devlog behind tiny page games
seo.description: A weekly devlog from Chris Cooley on building DOM VIRUS. Tiny open-source arcade games that play on a real webpage, and the engine under them.

sections.heading: The devlog
sections.body: The DOM VIRUS devlog, written by me, Chris Cooley. A new post lands every week. Where the ideas come from, how the games read the page and give it back, and what broke along the way.
